title: Battle of Britain Fighter Pilot Scramble
hook: Fighter pilots waited in deckchairs on airfield grass.

scenes.text: In the summer of 1940, young Spitfire pilots spent tense summer afternoons resting in wicker deckchairs beside airfield grass.
scenes.imagePrompt: Grassy English airfield with green canvas dispersal tent, empty wooden deckchairs, and a polished Supermarine Spitfire with elliptical wings parked behind. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: In the summer of 1940, young Spitfire pilots spent tense summer afternoons resting in wicker deckchairs beside airfield grass.

scenes.text: When the klaxon horn sounded a scramble call, pilots had under four minutes to sprint to their cockpits and fire up Merlin engines.

scenes.voicedText: When the klaxon horn sounded a scramble call, pilots had under four minutes to sprint to their cockpits and fire up Merlin engines.

scenes.text: At 20,000 feet over the English Channel, cockpit temperatures dropped below zero while pilots checked mirrors for diving German fighters.

scenes.text: A dogfight lasted barely ten minutes: eight Browning machine guns had only enough ammunition for fifteen seconds of continuous firing.
